vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: glm-master-skill
Version: 1.0.5

The 'glm-master-skill' is a documentation-only index for the GLM ecosystem. It contains no executable code, scripts, or subprocess calls, and explicitly states its purpose is to provide a catalog and installation guide for other skills. All instructions in SKILL.md are transparent, pointing to official GitHub repositories (zai-org) and standard installation methods (npx clawhub), with no evidence of malicious intent or prompt injection.

llm.summary: The skill is a documentation-only index that lists GLM ecosystem skills and install instructions; its declared footprint (no binaries, no env, no install) matches the content of SKILL.md.

dimensions.detail: Name and description state a documentation-only master skill. Declared requirements are empty and there are no code files or install steps in the package — this matches the cataloging and guidance purpose described in SKILL.md.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md contains only guidance: it recommends installing other skills (via 'npx clawhub' or cloning GitHub repos), points to other skills' SKILL.md files, and shows how to set a ZHIPU_API_KEY. It explicitly says it will not execute scripts or subprocesses. Note: the skill recommends actions (run npx, export API keys) that, if followed by a user/agent, will interact with the system or network — but those actions are recommended for the user and belong to the documented purpose.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files — lowest-risk instruction-only skill. The SKILL.md points to external installers (npx clawhub, git clone) but does not itself download or install anything.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill does not require environment variables. It documents that many GLM skills use ZHIPU_API_KEY and shows how to export it; this mention is informational and proportionate to the catalog's purpose but is not a required credential of this skill itself.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false, no install hooks or configuration writes, and the skill does not request persistent privileges. Autonomous invocation is allowed (platform default) but the skill content is passive documentation, not an autonomous actor that performs privileged operations.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is essentially a curated README for GLM ecosystem skills and appears internally consistent. Before using recommendations here: (1) review each referenced skill's SKILL.md and source repo before installing; (2) be cautious when running 'npx <package>' because npx will fetch and run remote code — prefer cloning and inspecting packages first; (3) only provide API keys (e.g., ZHIPU_API_KEY) to services you trust and avoid storing secrets in shared places; (4) verify the authenticity of the GitHub links and the clawhub/npm package if you plan to use them; (5) if you want to limit risk, require explicit user confirmation before any agent-run install commands.
llm.findings: [no_regex_findings] expected: The static scanner had no findings because this is an instruction-only skill with a single SKILL.md file and no code to analyze; that outcome is expected for a documentation-only skill.
